Warehousing

Área de kitting

A designated zone in a warehouse where parts or materials are gathered and assembled into kits for production, order fulfillment, or shipment, as referenced in warehouse work instructions and inventory control documentation.

Quick answer: A designated zone in a warehouse where parts or materials are gathered and assembled into kits for production, order fulfillment, or shipment, as referenced in warehouse work instructions and inventory control documentation.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Área de kitting?

In this glossary, Área de kitting refers to: A designated zone in a warehouse where parts or materials are gathered and assembled into kits for production, order fulfillment, or shipment, as referenced in warehouse work instructions and inventory control documentation.

How is Área de kitting used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Todos los artículos necesarios para cada pedido se preparan en el área de kitting antes del montaje y embalaje final."

Why does Área de kitting matter in logistics?

Área de kitting matters because it supports clear communication in Warehousing contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Área de kitting?

Área de kitting is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Área de kitting belong to?

In this glossary, Área de kitting is grouped under Warehousing. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A designated zone in a warehouse where parts or materials are gathered and assembled into kits for production, order fulfillment, or shipment, as referenced in warehouse work instructions and inventory control documentation.

Operational example

All items required for each order are staged in the kitting area prior to final assembly and packing.
